## XpmLiquidAction.\_isInitialised property

Flag indicating whether the action has been initialised.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected _isInitialised: boolean;
```

## Remarks

This flag ensures idempotent initialization and prevents redundant template evaluation when [XpmLiquidAction.initialise()](./xpm-lib.xpmliquidaction.initialise.md) is called multiple times.

State transitions:

1. Initially `false` after construction.

2. Set to `true` after successful command substitution and evaluation.

3. Checked at the start of [XpmLiquidAction.initialise()](./xpm-lib.xpmliquidaction.initialise.md) to return early if already initialised.

This pattern allows safe repeated calls during complex initialization sequences or when actions are accessed multiple times, avoiding the computational cost of re-evaluating templates unnecessarily.
